{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, stripping commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers, completed orders, and exclude refunded and QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') &
    (sales['revenue'] != 999999.99)
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue_clean = loyal_completed_clean['revenue'].mean()

# Count final rows
n_final = len(loyal_completed_clean)

# Print evidence
print(f'Number of LOYAL completed non-QA, non-refunded orders: {n_final}')
print(f'Mean revenue (clean): {mean_revenue_clean}')"}
